description: Accommodations for students who are blind, have low vision, or visual processing disorders
specific_accommodations: All course materials in accessible format (large print, Braille, or digital)
50% additional time on exams to accommodate assistive technology
Preferential seating near front with optimal lighting
Scribe for written exams or extended typing time
Modified lab assignments with tactile or audio alternatives
Orientation and mobility services for campus navigation
Early access to course materials for format conversion
notes: Submit course syllabi 4-6 weeks before semester for material conversion. Coordinate with adaptive technology lab for equipment setup.
